settings.content: Values used by the MegaSchema JSON-LD (snippets/mega-schema*.liquid). Social profiles come from Settings > Brand in the Shopify admin and from the Social media settings above.

settings.label: Schema source
settings.info: Legacy restores the theme's original microdata-schema snippet, for rollback.

settings.label: Logo for search engines
settings.info: At least 112 x 112 px, on a white or transparent background. Falls back to the logo in Settings > Brand.

settings.label: Country code
settings.info: Two-letter code. Also used for shipping and return policy countries.

settings.label: Extra profile URLs
settings.info: One URL per line, for profiles not in Brand or Social media settings (for example Amazon or Wikipedia).

settings.label: Brands
settings.info: Comma-separated brands this company owns and makes. Products from these brands (or with the shop name as vendor) list the company as manufacturer. Other vendors get a Brand entity on their product pages only.

settings.label: Handling days, minimum
settings.info: Confirm handling and transit times with operations.

settings.label: Return shipping fee
settings.info: Charged on returns that are not damaged, defective or shipped incorrectly. 0 means free returns.

settings.label: Final-sale product tags
settings.info: Comma-separated. Products with any of these tags are marked as not returnable.

settings.label: Show compare-at prices as strikethrough prices
settings.info: Google expects a strikethrough price to be a genuine former price.

settings.label: Collections to skip in product breadcrumbs
settings.info: Comma-separated collection handles. Used when a product is opened outside a collection.
